identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16a] Secure and durably persist three-voter OpenRaft transport

review_prompts: Can any node send or accept OpenRaft traffic without an authenticated encrypted session bound to the exact polis/domain/node generation?
Can any persistence or snapshot failure leave live or recovered state ahead of the last durable commit?
Do the tests exercise real network encryption, three-to-two, one-of-three halt, restart, replay, corruption and path attacks?
residual_risk: PR #197 remains intentionally unmerged pending operator and external review after same-PR update.
